description: The focal-method set the experiments are run over. A method is identified by project, file, name and start line; the line range, cyclomatic complexity and branch count are recorded so a later run can confirm it is looking at the same code and not a shifted copy. Drive a sweep from this file rather than from a fresh discovery pass, or two runs are measuring different populations.
note_on_duplicates: The sweep of 2026-09 ran 1288 manifest entries, of which two re2 methods appear twice and were scored twice. This file lists each method once, so it holds 1286.
